name: zxspectrum-debug
description: Registers the 'zxspectrum' debugger type so launch.json's debugServer field can connect directly to zx-spectrum-emulator's DAP server, and provides a live screen viewer fed by the emulator's screen-stream port. No adapter code -- debugServer overrides how VS Code connects to the debugger itself.

rom.description: Path to a 16K ROM image to load.

snapshot.description: Path to a .sna snapshot to load. Falls back to reset() if omitted.

sld.description: Path to an sjasmplus SLD file, for source-level debugging of the loaded program. Requires asm.

asm.description: Path to the source the sld file was assembled from. Requires sld.
